Leaflet GPT

Leaflet GPT

Leaflet GPT: AI for Competitive Pricing Generation.

Leaflet GPT is an advanced generative AI multimodal application designed to analyze leaflet PDFs from any store. It extracts detailed information, including discounted and current prices, units, and product attributes. Once the data is fetched, Leaflet GPT maps it to our current database, creating a comprehensive table that enables competitive pricing analysis. This powerful tool ensures accurate, up-to-date pricing information, allowing for effective market comparison and pricing strategy optimization.
